screened.label: Screenings recorded
screened.numerator: Submitted screenings measured in the period

peopleScreened.label: People screened
peopleScreened.numerator: Distinct people with at least one submitted screening in the period

flagged.label: Flagged for review
flagged.numerator: Screenings the demo rule flagged for clinician review

reviewed.label: Clinically reviewed
reviewed.numerator: Flagged screenings with an action recorded or dismissed with a reason

dismissed.label: Dismissed with reason
dismissed.numerator: Flagged screenings a clinician dismissed with a recorded reason (never completed care)

actioned.label: Action recorded
actioned.numerator: Flagged screenings whose review recorded an action

referred.label: Referred or follow-up planned
referred.numerator: Reviewed flags with an active referral or a planned follow-up

followUpCompleted.label: Follow-up completed
followUpCompleted.numerator: Screenings with a referral completed with evidence, or a follow-up completed with an outcome

medianDaysToReview.label: Median days to review
medianDaysToReview.numerator: Median of days from measurement to the first clinical review decision

weeklyScreenedVsFlagged.label: Screenings per week
weeklyScreenedVsFlagged.numerator: Screenings and flagged screenings per Kigali ISO week (Monday start)

screeningType.label: Screening type
screeningType.numerator: Screenings with blood pressure only, glucose only, or both

overdueReferrals.label: Overdue referrals
overdueReferrals.numerator: Incomplete referrals whose person-set due date has passed

overdueFollowUps.label: Overdue follow-ups
overdueFollowUps.numerator: Incomplete follow-ups whose person-set due date has passed

pendingReviewAge.label: Pending review age
pendingReviewAge.numerator: Flagged screenings still waiting for review, by days since measurement

openQualityIssues.label: Open data-quality issues
openQualityIssues.numerator: Detected data-quality issues not yet triaged — the Open tab on Safety & quality

workloadMinutes.label: Staff time per patient-day (proxy)
workloadMinutes.numerator: Self-reported demo minutes per patient-day — shown on Worker workload

promptIdReliability.label: Prompt and ID reliability
promptIdReliability.numerator: Identity mismatches and missed-flag proxies — shown on Safety & quality

medicineHistoryCompleteness.label: Medicine-history completeness
medicineHistoryCompleteness.numerator: No medicine-history field in the NCD MVP

patientUnderstanding.label: Patient understanding
patientUnderstanding.numerator: No patient-understanding field in the NCD MVP

denominator.patientDays: Patient-days: distinct (patient, Kigali day) contacts of each worker from screenings and contact attempts, summed over workers
denominator.tasksAssigned: Follow-up tasks assigned in the period

inclusion.cohort: Submitted screenings only (drafts excluded); people who withdrew consent excluded; an amended screening counts once
inclusion.proxy: Synthetic self-reported demo time entries only — a proxy measure, not a measured workload or an individual performance measure
inclusion.reviewProxy: Decided reviews of the period's flagged screenings — a proxy derived from review outcomes, not a measure of clinical accuracy

attribution.period: Period = Kigali date of the measurement
attribution.cohort: Reviews, referrals and follow-ups count in the period of their originating screening
attribution.snapshot: Records of the period's screenings, as of now (demo clock)
attribution.reviewWeek: Week = Kigali ISO week (Monday start) of the review decision
attribution.weekEnd: Counted at each week's end (Sunday 23:59 Kigali); the last point is now (demo clock)
attribution.taskCreated: Exception to cohort attribution: a task counts in the period of its assignment date (createdAt), because workload is about when work happened
attribution.timeEntry: Period = date of the time entry and Kigali date of each contact
attribution.detection: Screening issues count in the period of the measurement; duplicate identifiers in the period of the latest patient registration
attribution.audit: Period = Kigali date of the audit event

p90DaysToReview.label: 90th percentile days to review
p90DaysToReview.numerator: 90th percentile of days from measurement to the first clinical review decision

reviewsPending.label: Reviews pending
reviewsPending.numerator: Flagged screenings whose review is pending or in review (shown by age; no review target is approved)

medianDaysToReferralCompletion.label: Median days to referral completion
medianDaysToReferralCompletion.numerator: Median of days from measurement to the recorded completion evidence of a completed referral

weeklyMedianDaysToReview.label: Median days to review per week
weeklyMedianDaysToReview.numerator: Median days to review per Kigali ISO week of the review decision, with n

weeklyOverdueTrend.label: Overdue trend
weeklyOverdueTrend.numerator: Incomplete referrals and follow-ups whose clinician-set due date had passed at the end of each week (the last point is now)

medianDaysByFacility.label: Median days to review by facility
medianDaysByFacility.numerator: Median days to review per facility, with n

method.percentile: Linear interpolation between closest ranks: rank h = (n − 1) × p / 100; value = x[⌊h⌋] + (h − ⌊h⌋) × (x[⌊h⌋+1] − x[⌊h⌋]). Hidden when n is below the small-cell threshold.
method.ratioOfSums: Pooled value = total minutes ÷ total patient-days (a ratio of sums, not the mean of per-worker ratios). Hidden when patient-days are below the small-cell threshold.
method.baselineIndex: Index = current minutes per patient-day ÷ minutes per patient-day in the DEMO BASELINE window (the first 4 seeded weeks — not an approved baseline). Not shown when either side has fewer patient-days than the small-cell threshold.

activeWorkers.label: Active workers
activeWorkers.numerator: Workers with at least one time entry, screening, task or contact attempt in the period

tasksAssigned.label: Follow-up tasks assigned
tasksAssigned.numerator: Follow-up tasks with an assigned worker, created in the period

tasksCompleted.label: Tasks completed
tasksCompleted.numerator: Of those, tasks with status completed and a completion time

tasksUnableToReach.label: Unable to reach
tasksUnableToReach.numerator: Of those, tasks closed as unable to reach or reassigned

tasksOverdue.label: Task status
tasksOverdue.numerator: Tasks by status: completed, in progress, unable to reach, and overdue (still open and past the person-set due date)

minutesPerPatientDayIndex.label: Minutes per patient-day index
minutesPerPatientDayIndex.numerator: Current minutes per patient-day divided by the value in the demo baseline window

minutesByActivity.label: Minutes by activity
minutesByActivity.numerator: Self-reported demo minutes per activity (screening, follow-up, travel, admin)

weeklyMinutesPerPatientDay.label: Minutes per patient-day per week
weeklyMinutesPerPatientDay.numerator: Self-reported demo minutes per Kigali ISO week

qualityMissingFields.label: Screenings with missing required fields
qualityMissingFields.numerator: Submitted screenings missing at least one mandatory field (patient, facility, author, time, source, ruleset version; glucose unit and context when glucose is recorded; both blood-pressure values)

qualityMissingByField.label: Missing fields by field
qualityMissingByField.numerator: Screenings missing each mandatory field (one screening can miss several)

identityMismatches.label: Possible identity mismatches
identityMismatches.numerator: Patient records sharing one synthetic identifier (one per group) plus screenings with no patient record in scope

overturnedFlagRate.label: Overturned flags (proxy)
overturnedFlagRate.numerator: Reviewed flags dismissed with a reason — a proxy, not clinical accuracy

missedFlagProxy.label: Missed-flag proxy
missedFlagProxy.numerator: Manual escalations of screenings the demo rule did not flag — a proxy, not clinical accuracy

duplicateSubmissionsPrevented.label: Duplicate submissions prevented
duplicateSubmissionsPrevented.numerator: Replayed submissions collapsed by the repository's idempotency check (audit events)

completedWithoutEvidence.label: Completed referrals without evidence
completedWithoutEvidence.numerator: Completed referrals lacking a completion time or evidence — must be 0 (invariant check)

weeklyQualityTrend.label: Weekly quality trend
weeklyQualityTrend.numerator: Screenings with missing fields and identity mismatches per Kigali ISO week

flagReviewOutcomesByGroup.label: Flag review outcomes by group (proxy)
flagReviewOutcomesByGroup.numerator: Flagged, overturned and manually escalated screenings by sex and age band — a fairness signal, not a clinical-accuracy measure

dismissalReasonDistribution.label: Dismissal reasons
dismissalReasonDistribution.numerator: Dismissed flags by structured reason code (free text is never shown)
